findings.identity: The French distributor explicitly lists the 63-minute making-of, the workshop and costume bonus segments, and the 7-minute Anatomy of Three Scenes on the French disc. The catalog entry has no inspectable footwear frame from those extras.
The person reviewing the French disc identifies the Missionary attack as one of the three scene breakdowns. This is a locator for checking the disc, not visual evidence of a costume part.
Film credits name Liise Keeling as the Stunt Missionary. A search for production-stage photos or a stunt reel did not establish footwear.

The Premiere Props sale records archived on this page document costumes of Harry, Vincent, Heather, Young Alessa and Happy Burger staff, and rabbit props. They do not provide a Missionary footwear lot.
Public clip index locates a 20-second motel sequence at film time 40:28. Native video access returned HTTP 403; no frame verified. No retry.
